title: Skydiving: from first jump to pro
intro: Every step of learning to skydive in the UK, in order. Start with a tandem, train on AFF or the Category System, then work through the licences, disciplines and ratings at your own pace.

items.summary: Your first skydive, strapped to an instructor.
AFF, the fast track: real freefall from jump one with two instructors.
The Category System (static line): ground school, then solo jumps at your own pace.
Consolidation jumps, the canopy exam and your first licence.
50 jumps, JM1 and CT1: jump master duties and your own kit.
200 jumps, CT2 and a second grade 1 sticker: cameras and coaching.
1,000 jumps: the top licence, needed to become an AFF instructor.
FS, FF, CT, tracking, canopy formation and wingsuit, and what each needs.
Foundation and Advanced coach, plus the CSI, TI and AFFI instructor ratings.
UKSL, Grand Prix, the Nationals and the world stage.
Age, weight, membership, prices and kit rules.
